auth.blurb: Every case, visit, medication and report your care team records — visible to you, in plain language, wherever you are.

chart.glanceSub: Every chart has a table view — press Table to read the numbers.
chart.visitsOverTimeSub: Visits recorded for you, month by month.
chart.caseDistributionSub: How your {{ total }} cases stand today.
chart.perProfessionalSub: Who has been involved in your care.
chart.trendSummary: {{ firstValue }} {{ unit }} on {{ firstLabel }} to {{ lastValue }} {{ unit }} on {{ lastLabel }}, trending {{ direction }}.

overview.heroBlurb: Everything your care team has recorded — cases, visits, medications and reports — in one place.
overview.vitalsSub: The most recent measurement your care team recorded.
overview.noVitalsHint: Vitals appear here once your care team records them.
overview.heroNext: Your next appointment is {{ when }} with {{ clinician }}.
overview.onFileSub: Tap any tile to open it.
overview.heroCases: {{ open }} of your {{ total }} cases are still active.

record.vitalsSub: Pick a reading to see how it has moved.
record.noCareTeamHint: The professionals looking after you will be listed here.
record.listsSub: Three at a time — page through here, or open the full list.

cases.emptyHint: A case is opened whenever your care team looks into something.

archived.title: Archived ({{count}})
archived.hint: A member of your care team retired these from the active list. They stay on your record.

case.noSymptoms: No symptoms were recorded for this case.
case.noDiagnosis: No diagnosis has been recorded yet.
case.noRecommendations: No recommendations recorded for this case.
case.noVisits: No visits recorded against this case
case.noMedications: No medications prescribed for this case
case.noReports: No reports filed against this case
case.noTimeline: Nothing has been logged against this case
case.notFoundHint: It may have been closed, or the link may be out of date.
case.logActivityBlurb: Add something you noticed — a symptom, a missed dose, how you slept. It is filed under this case and your care team sees it.
case.noteDetailHint: When it started, how long it lasted, anything that helped…
case.noteFailed: Your note was not saved. Check your connection and try again — what you wrote is still here.
case.filedUnderSub: Your own notes appear here too.

schedules.search: Search by date, professional or appointment…
schedules.pastSub: Appointments that have been and gone.
schedules.emptyHint: New appointments appear here as your care team books them.

emergencies.careLineBlurb: The care line is staffed around the clock and your care angel is called at the same time. If this is life-threatening, call your local emergency number first.
emergencies.emptyHint: Alerts raised on your record appear here, with what came of them.

medications.emptyHint: Anything prescribed to you appears here, current and past.
medications.withheldBody: This was not given because of an allergy recorded on your file.

reports.emptyHint: Lab, imaging and clinical reports appear here once filed.
reports.uploadBlurb: A result you were given on paper, or a PDF from a clinic. Your care team sees it on your record.
reports.fileHint: PDF or a photograph, up to 10 MB.
reports.name: What is it
reports.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB. A photograph taken at a lower resolution will fit.
reports.uploadFailed: Your report was not uploaded. Check your connection and try again — what you typed is still here.

plans.emptyHint: Your care team can set one up at your next appointment.

allergies.emptyHint: Tell your care team about any reaction so it can be recorded here.
allergies.onRecordBlurb: Every professional who opens your context sees this panel first, and prescribing is blocked against it.
allergies.blockedSub: Prescriptions your team withheld because of an allergy.

visitations.emptyHint: Every visit your care team logs will appear here.

activity.emptyHint: Everything filed on your record shows up here, newest first.

profile.noProfileHint: Your care team creates this when you register.
profile.noMembershipHint: Speak to your care team about joining a plan.

careAngel.explainer: A care angel can see and update your health record, and act for you if you are ever unable to. Nothing happens until they accept, and you can withdraw it at any time.
careAngel.noneHint: Nobody is currently able to act for you.

status.STANDBY: Standby — dormant until a clinician activates them
status.AWAITING_COUNTERSIGNATURE: Waiting for a second clinician to agree

error.revokeFailed: That could not be withdrawn. Try again.

plan.unavailable: Plans cannot be shown just now. Nothing about your record is affected.

error.failed: That plan could not be selected. Try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your record
onboarding.heading: Let us set up your record
onboarding.intro: Each step is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back.

field.medications: Medicines you take, one per line

careAngel.explainer: A care angel can see and update your health record, and act for you if you are ever unable to. They are asked to accept, and you can withdraw this at any time.

standby.heading: If you are ever unable to decide
standby.explainer: You can name somebody in advance. They are told nothing now. If a clinician ever declares that you cannot decide for yourself, two of them must agree before this person is asked — and they can still say no.
standby.consent: If I am ever unable to decide for myself, a clinician may activate my standby nominee.

error.emailMismatch: The two email addresses do not match.
error.consentRequired: Tick the consent box to name a standby nominee, or leave their details blank.
error.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Nothing you have already answered is lost — try again.

actingAs.bannerOwn: You are viewing your own record
actingAs.chooseTitle: Whose record would you like to open?
actingAs.chooseLede: You can act for more than one person. Everything you see next belongs to whoever you pick.

invitations.title: Care nominations
invitations.heading: Care nominations
invitations.empty: You have no nominations waiting. If somebody has just named you, check the link in the email they were sent.
invitations.from: {{name}} has asked you to be their care angel
invitations.explainer: Accepting means you will be able to see and update their health record, and act for them if they are ever unable to. You can step down at any time, and they can withdraw it at any time.

error.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

stream.offline: We could not reach Health Connect. Check your connection and try again.
stream.forbidden: You do not have access to this part of the record.
stream.generic: Something went wrong loading this. Please try again.

finder.title: Find a patient
finder.blurb: You have no record of your own. Open a patient's record to see the portal as they see it — everything you do while it is open is recorded against your own account.
finder.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, phone or patient id
finder.failed: The patient list could not be loaded
finder.failedBlurb: This is a failed request, not an empty system. Try again, and check the connection if it keeps failing.
finder.none: There are no patient records yet
finder.narrow: More patients match than are shown. Narrow the search to find the one you want.

intro.title: Delete your record
intro.body: You can ask us to delete your health record and everything in it. We carry it out within 14 days, and you can withdraw the request at any point before then.
intro.review: An administrator carries out the deletion, so that nothing is erased by a single tap.
intro.policyHint: The policy opens in your browser and says what we keep and for how long.

confirm.title: Delete your record?
confirm.body: This asks us to erase your health record. It cannot be undone once carried out.

item.record: Your profile, conditions, medications and allergies
item.clinical: Your cases, reports, care plans and visits
item.delegations: Anyone's permission to act for you

confirm.window: Your record will be deleted within 14 days of this request. You can withdraw it at any time before then.
confirm.reasonPlaceholder: You do not have to tell us.

pending.title: Your record is scheduled for deletion
pending.body: We will delete your record and everything in it by {{date}}.
pending.keepHint: You can change your mind at any time until the deletion is carried out.

angel.title: Not available while acting for someone
angel.body: You are viewing another person's record. Only they can ask for it to be deleted.

error.load: We could not check whether you have a deletion request open.
error.raise: We could not record your request. Please try again.
error.cancel: We could not withdraw your request. Please try again.

lock.title: Abofonsa BridgeCare is locked
lock.lede: You have been away for a while. Unlock to see your health record again.
lock.reason: Unlock to see your health record

error.unavailable: This device has no screen lock, so your session cannot be kept. Please sign in again.
error.failed: We could not verify it was you. Try again, or sign in with your password.

forkFailed.title: We could not open your records

error.session: Health Connect would not confirm your session. Try again, or sign in again.
error.generic: Something went wrong while opening your records. Please try again.

deadEnd.browserNote: The link opens in your browser, so your saved password is available there.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up your record
onboarding.body: Your account is ready. Setting up your health record is done on the web — it takes a few minutes, and this app shows a record that already exists rather than creating one. Come back here afterwards and sign in again.

invitations.title: You have an invitation waiting
invitations.body: Someone has asked you to be their care angel. You do not have a record of your own, so there is nothing to show here yet. Accept or decline the invitation on the web, then come back.

exit.title: Close BridgeCare?
exit.body: You will need to unlock again next time.
